original_text.raw_value: In a Schlenk tube, allene substrates (0.2 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and phosphine oxides 2 (0.4 mmol, 2.0 equiv) were placed with a magnetic stir bar under a N2 atmosphere. 1,2-Dichloroethane (2 mL, 0.1 M) and 2,6-lutidine (47 μL, 0.4 mmol) were added by a syringe sequentially. After homogenization, Tf2O (67 μL, 0.4 mmol) was added by syringe and the mixture was stirred 2 h at room temperature; it was poured into saturated NaHCO3, extracted with CH2Cl2, dried over anhydrous Na2SO4, concentrated, and purified by short silica-gel chromatography.

After homogenization, Tf2O (67 μL, 0.4 mmol) was added by syringe and the mixture was stirred 2 h at room temperature; it was poured into saturated NaHCO3, extracted with CH2Cl2, dried over anhydrous Na2SO4, concentrated, and purified by short silica-gel chromatography.
